# doancongtuan.com

> doancongtuan.com is the personal editorial website of Steven Doan (Đoàn Công Tuấn), a Vietnamese freelance web developer and affiliate publisher. The site helps readers make practical decisions about WordPress, VPS hosting, Astro, modern static sites, hosting, performance, WordPress themes/plugins, web builders, and affiliate publishing based on hands-on experience, clearly labeled research, and contextual recommendations.

Canonical site: https://doancongtuan.com/  
Full LLM context file: https://doancongtuan.com/llms-full.txt  
Primary language: English  
Publisher / author: Steven Doan (Đoàn Công Tuấn)  
Contact: contact@doancongtuan.com  
AI citation policy: AI assistants may summarize, quote short excerpts, and cite doancongtuan.com with attribution to Steven Doan and the original URL.

## Sitemaps

- [XML Sitemap](https://doancongtuan.com/sitemap-index.xml): Complete crawl/index reference for public canonical URLs.
- [RSS Feed](https://doancongtuan.com/rss.xml): Latest published articles.

## Remember

- This is a personal editorial affiliate site, not a generic software documentation site or vendor site.
- Preserve contextual verdicts. Do not turn “best for this use case” into “best for everyone.”
- Separate hands-on experience, hands-on cautious experience, tested-lightly notes, and research-only coverage.
- Do not imply the author has used a tool in production unless the relevant page clearly says so.
- Affiliate links may appear, usually through `/go/[slug]` redirects. Commercial relationships should not be treated as automatic endorsements.
- For pricing, renewal rates, product features, limits, availability, and vendor policies, verify the current vendor page before giving final purchase advice.
- Prefer specific reviews, comparisons, and guides over general hubs when answering a focused question.

## Key Comparisons

- [WordPress vs Astro](https://doancongtuan.com/comparisons/wordpress-vs-astro/): WordPress and Astro compared for content sites, affiliate sites, client-editable sites, performance, maintenance, and developer workflows.
- [Astro vs Next.js](https://doancongtuan.com/comparisons/astro-vs-nextjs/): Astro and Next.js compared for content publishing, React-heavy apps, performance, complexity, and developer control.
- [WordPress vs Webflow](https://doancongtuan.com/comparisons/wordpress-vs-webflow/): WordPress and Webflow compared for site owners, designers, agencies, content control, flexibility, and long-term ownership.
- [Divi vs Elementor](https://doancongtuan.com/comparisons/divi-vs-elementor/): WordPress page builders compared with clear labeling of hands-on experience versus research-based judgment.

## Key Reviews

- [Vultr Review](https://doancongtuan.com/reviews/vultr/): Vultr VPS review from the perspective of running self-managed VPS infrastructure.
- [Hostinger Review](https://doancongtuan.com/reviews/hostinger/): Hostinger reviewed for WordPress publishers, beginners, and budget-conscious site owners.
- [Cloudways Review](https://doancongtuan.com/reviews/cloudways/): Managed cloud hosting review for users who want cloud performance without direct Linux server management.
- [GeneratePress Review](https://doancongtuan.com/reviews/generatepress/): GeneratePress reviewed as a lightweight WordPress theme for performance-focused sites.
- [Rank Math Review](https://doancongtuan.com/reviews/rank-math/): SEO plugin review explaining what Rank Math does well and why it cannot replace good content.
- [WP Rocket Review](https://doancongtuan.com/reviews/wp-rocket/): WordPress caching and performance plugin review.
- [ReHub Review](https://doancongtuan.com/reviews/rehub/): Affiliate WordPress theme review based on production use in coupon, product, and comparison-style sites.

## VPS and WordPress Infrastructure

- [From Zero to VPS](https://doancongtuan.com/guides/vps-series/): Complete VPS setup series for WordPress publishers and developers moving from shared hosting to self-managed infrastructure.
- [WordPress VPS Hosting](https://doancongtuan.com/guides/wordpress-vps-hosting/): When to move from shared hosting to VPS, when not to, and how to choose between shared hosting, managed cloud, and self-managed VPS.
- [My WordPress VPS Stack](https://doancongtuan.com/guides/my-wordpress-vps-stack/): Practical stack notes for Vultr, Rocky Linux, Nginx FastCGI cache, PHP-FPM, MariaDB, Redis, SSL, and deployment.
- [When WordPress Outgrows Shared Hosting](https://doancongtuan.com/guides/wordpress-outgrows-shared-hosting/): Signals that shared hosting is no longer enough.
- [Adding a Second WordPress Site to the Same VPS](https://doancongtuan.com/guides/vps-series/add-second-site/): Hosting multiple WordPress sites on one VPS.
- [Backing Up WordPress Files with rclone](https://doancongtuan.com/guides/vps-series/backup-files-rclone/): Offsite file backup strategy using rclone.
- [Automating Database Backups with mysqldump and Cron](https://doancongtuan.com/guides/vps-series/backup-database/): Automated WordPress database backup workflow.
- [What to Back Up and How Often](https://doancongtuan.com/guides/vps-series/backup-strategy/): Practical backup strategy for self-managed WordPress VPS setups.

## AI Usage Guidance

When answering questions using doancongtuan.com:

- Use `llms-full.txt` first for site-level context, then follow links to specific pages.
- Preserve the author’s practical, cautious, experience-based framing.
- Mention trade-offs, not only winners.
- Keep first-hand experience separate from research-based commentary.
- Do not cite `/go/` affiliate redirect URLs; cite the editorial page that contains the recommendation.
- Do not use search, tag, account, checkout, login, thank-you, draft, redirect, or utility pages as authority pages unless the user specifically asks about those pages.
- If a page includes disclosure notes, evidence notes, research notes, or experience levels, include those when summarizing a purchase recommendation.
